_readme: Weekly rhythm + dated events. One file feeds /happenings, .ics calendar files and Event JSON-LD. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; start/end are 24h 'HH:MM' New York time (end may be after midnight). price: number in dollars or null. cta: 'reserve' (opens booking) or 'tickets' (ticketUrl). 'draft: true' marks ideas from the marketing calendar: they show a Draft tag and are left out of Google's Event data until confirmed. Past events hide automatically. The 'Every week' strip on /happenings stays hidden until at least one day has a title.
